entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to return something. It's the... VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I just... I can't figure it out.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, can I have your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th, so about 21 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, I don't think. It's just so confusing. I really expected more from the interface. It's just very hard to use.
I see. Sometimes the advanced features can take a little getting used to. For instance, are you having trouble with a specific function, like setting up your heart rate zones?
Yes, that! And just navigating the menus. I've read the user manual a couple of times and it still feels overwhelming. I'm just not getting it. Can't you just help me? I'd rather just return it.
Of course, I understand completely. It's important you have a product you feel comfortable with. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I've pulled up our policy, and it looks like items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 21, you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! Thank you so much, David. That's a huge relief.

You are very welcome. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, thank you! No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure, Sarah. Have a great day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
